jobs.title: Exploratory Test Engineer & Scrum Master (On-site, German Required) IRC301687
jobs.description:
Description

About the Client

Our client is a global leader in eye care, dedicated to improving lives by enhancing sight. With a strong portfolio of innovative products—including contact lenses, eye care solutions, and surgical instruments for cataract and retina procedures—they serve customers in over 140 countries. By advancing cutting-edge technologies and solutions, they continue to shape the future of eye health worldwide.

About The Project

As part of their ongoing innovation, our client is enhancing their medical devices with advanced connectivity features and cloud-based services. Since adoption of next-generation solutions is gradual, the project must ensure smooth integration between legacy and modern systems in real-world environments.

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. To achieve this, our client is now scaling up the software engineering team and seeking skilled professionals to join this critical phase of development.

Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. Both systems are safety-classified software under IEC 62304 and require rigorous test coverage. The Scrum Master is a key role responsible for enabling team effectiveness and high-quality delivery in a safety-critical, highly regulated environment.

Core Qualifications Include:

3+ years of experience in exploratory or hands-on functional software testing, ideally on real embedded hardware or medical devices.
Familiarity with Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) or comparable structured exploratory testing approaches.
Practical experience with Azure DevOps (backlog management, sprint boards, defect tracking, build/release pipelines).
Solid understanding of Windows desktop application testing (UI workflows, configuration, error handling).
Ability to read and interpret C++ application architecture and system integration diagrams for test planning purposes.
Experience working in Agile teams using feature-driven development, time-boxing, and artifact management.
Interpersonal skills with a proven ability to achieve constructive solutions in cross-departmental topics, as well as in organizing and motivating team members.
Fluent English; intermediate-level German. Onsite, Erlangen, no home office

Job responsibilities

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies for the FrontEnd team (sprint planning, daily stand-up, sprint review, retrospective) and optionally a second team (VideoUnit).
Coach team members on Agile/Scrum principles, continuous improvement, and self-organization; act as a servant leader and team advocate.
Identify and actively remove impediments; manage cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers to management as needed.
Maintain team health metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, defect aging) and communicate progress transparently to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, sprint goal clarity, and Definition of Done alignment.
Support adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tooling within the team.
Facilitate continuous process improvement using retrospective data; drive Agile maturity across one or two Scrum teams.
Plan, design, and execute exploratory test sessions on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device (hardware-in-the-loop), focusing on clinical user workflows of the FrontEnd application.
Apply Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) and exploratory test charters; document findings with clear reproducibility steps and severity classification.
Collaborate with software engineers and verification engineers to triage defects; create and track issues in Azure DevOps.
Contribute to test strategy and risk-based coverage decisions alongside the Quality and Architecture team.
Produce lightweight test artifacts required under IEC 62304 (test session reports, defect records, anomaly reports) in coordination with the Quality team.
Validate integration of FrontEnd with BackEnd, VideoUnit, and Refractive Server Device (RSD) at the system level during sprint deliveries.

What we offer

Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.

Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.

DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity
. We are dedicated to providing equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive
and empowering work environment.

Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.

Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.

Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

jobs.description:
Über T-Systems International GmbH

Bei T-Systems bieten wir unseren Geschäftskunden die richtigen Systemlösungen für ihr digitales Business. Mit unserem Portfolio stellen wir sicher, dass digitale Transformation Komplexität reduziert, Kosten einspart und die alltägliche Arbeit erleichtert. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Konnektivität, Digital, Cloud & Infrastruktur sowie Sicherheit - Let's power higher performance!

Die Unit Cloud Services agiert auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene für mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln, vermarkten und betreiben agile, cloud-native, zukunftsorientierte Produkte und Services für die digitale Welt. Wir verstehen uns als Innovationstreiber und machen das Geschäft unserer Kunden fit für die digitale Zukunft. Unsere Mission: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden gestalten wir die sicherste, einfachste und effizienteste Transformation in eine digitalisierte und cloud-native Zukunft.

Dein Bereich

Wir betreiben T Cloud Public! T Cloud Public ist Europas #1 Cloud Provider, ein Cloud-Standardprodukt auf Basis von Open-Source-Community-Software und angetrieben durch die Prinzipien von DevSecOps. Schlanke Strukturen, agile Methoden, hochmotivierte Teams und ein äußerst dynamisches Geschäftsumfeld bestimmen unser Handeln. Mit dieser kundenorientierten und agilen Ausrichtung sind wir der Ankerpunkt für das Public-Cloud-Geschäft in der Deutschen Telekom Gruppe.

Wir werden daran gemessen, eine sichere, stabile und innovative Plattform bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Plattformpartner und weiteren Partnern aus dem OpenStack-Ökosystem arbeiten wir daran, ein hochinnovatives Public-Cloud-Produkt auf Basis europäischer Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards zu schaffen.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Profis und Evangelisten mit großer Begeisterung für Cloud-Technologie sind und sich den Herausforderungen stellen, die durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb einer Hyperscale-Public-Cloud entstehen.

Wir bieten einzigartige Einblicke darin, wie eine große Public Cloud unter der Haube funktioniert, interkulturelle Teamarbeit, flache Hierarchien und einen eigenständigen Arbeitsstil.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Architect verstehst du die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Cloud- und Container-Technologie. Kundenorientiert entwickelst und erweiterst du die Plattform unserer Open Telekom Cloud.

Du möchtest:

Die Plattformarchitektur verbessern und dabei IT-Sicherheit ernst nehmen.
Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich Hardware Security Modules wären von Vorteil.
Innovative Plattform- und Software-as-a-Service-Features entwerfen und entwickeln.
Als vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in für OpenStack-basierte Public-Cloud-Technologie agieren.
Praktisch an der Konsole arbeiten, um deine Architekturarbeit zu untermauern.
Konsequente Automatisierung mit gängigen Automatisierungsframeworks vorantreiben.
In einem Team von Spezialist:innen arbeiten, in dem sich alle gegenseitig offen und vertrauensvoll unterstützen.

Dein Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fach oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT mit Schwerpunkt auf modernen Cloud-Technologien.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Software-, Cloud- und Container-Architekturen.
Erfahrung in der Infrastrukturautomatisierung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Linux, Systemtools und netzwerkbezogenen Services.
Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.
Kenntnisse agiler Entwicklungsprozesse.
Mentoring- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen zu bewerten und kreative Ansätze zu entwickeln.
OpenStack- und Programmiererfahrung in Open-Source-Projekten sind von Vorteil.
Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse.
Du arbeitest innerhalb der Europäischen Union, um die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an Datensicherheit und Datenschutz zu erfüllen.

Was wir bieten

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle:
Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel mit Gleitzeit und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal zu vereinbaren.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket:
Profitiere von einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und weiteren Sozialleistungen.

Individuelle Entwicklung:
Wir fördern deine Karriere durch vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zertifizierungen (insbesondere in Cloud-Technologien und Architektur), Konferenzen und interne Entwicklungsprogramme.

Innovation und Technologie:
Arbeite an vorderster Front mit modernsten Cloud-Technologien (Public Cloud, Kubernetes, IaC) und gestalte aktiv die digitale Zukunft mit.

Teamgeist und Kollegialität:
Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, in der Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden.

Work-Life-Balance:
Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub, umfassende Gesundheitsangebote und Programme zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:
Ausgestattet mit State-of-the-Art-Equipment und inspirierenden Arbeitsplätzen in unseren Büros oder komfortables mobiles Arbeiten.

statworx ist ein führendes Beratungs- und Entwicklungsunternehmen für Daten & KI in der DACH-Region. Seit über einem Jahrzehnt unterstützen wir Unternehmen mit Beratung, Entwicklung und Weiterbildung – in mehr als 1.000 erfolgreichen Projekten für über 100 Kunden aus nahezu allen Branchen.

Unser Ziel: Creating value from Data & AI.

Unsere AI Development-Abteilung dient als Katalysator für Data & AI Transformation. Dabei setzen wir auf eine ganzheitliche Herangehensweise, die von der initialen Evaluierung der KI-Reife über die Konzeption und Ausarbeitung der Daten- und KI-Lösung bis hin zur praktischen Umsetzung und Skalierung von KI-Lösungen reicht. Durch unsere tiefgehende Expertise in Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kunden den maximalen Nutzen aus ihren Daten ziehen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Projektteams entwirfst du Cloud- und Softwarelösungen für Daten, KI und ML-Projekte und verantwortest sie hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Wartbarkeit, Sicherheit, Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosten
Du übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in technische Konzepte, erstellst Projektvorschläge und präsentierst unsere technischen Lösungen

Du nimmst aktiv an verschiedenen Formaten des internen Wissensaustauschs teil

Dein Profil

Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes (Master)-Studium, vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Software Development, Software Engineering, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation
Du bringst mehr als 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung als Solution Architect, Lead Software/Cloud Developer oder in einer vergleichbaren Position mit und hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Data Science, KI und Machine Learning
Du besitzt umfassende Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Software- und Cloud-Lösungen in verschiedenen Umgebungen und für unterschiedliche Anwendungsfälle
Du verfügst über fundierte Expertise in mindestens einer Cloud-Plattform (Azure, GCP, AWS) idealerweise mit entsprechender Zertifizierung als Cloud Solution Architect

Transparente Vergütung: Wir bieten faire, strukturierte und nachvollziehbare Gehaltsstufen, die regelmäßig an Markt- und Leistungsentwicklungen angepasst werden

jobs.title: Senior Software Architect, IIoT Platform (Netilion) - m/f/d
jobs.description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.   

We are looking for a Senior Software Architect to join Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions and strengthen the long-term evolution of the Netilion ecosystem. Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions is our Product Center for the Industrial Internet of Things—where 200 innovators collaborate in 12 agile squads, backed by over 200 IIoT patents and an ISO 27001-certified commitment to security—to deliver cutting-edge hardware, software, and cloud services that unlock the full potential of process-industry data.

What is the role about?

As Senior Software Architect, you are responsible for the overall technical design of the Netilion platform. You ensure that all parts of the platform, including Cloud, Edge, Connectivity and Hybrid solutions, work together in a consistent, secure and scalable way.

You define the technical direction of the platform, support important technology decisions and help engineering teams build solutions that fit the long-term strategy.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

Define and maintain the overall architecture of the Netilion platform.
Align technical solutions with business goals and product requirements.
Lead architecture reviews and support key technology decisions.
Ensure the platform remains scalable, secure, reliable and easy to maintain.
Establish architecture standards, API guidelines and best practices.
Identify technical risks and manage technical debt.
Support and mentor architects, technical leads and engineering teams.
Promote consistency and collaboration across teams and products.

What do we expect from you?

You:

Bring several years of experience in a senior technical leadership role such as Software Architect, Platform Architect, Principal Engineer or Enterprise Architect.
Have strong knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, security, connectivity and data architectures.
Have experience defining technical standards and guiding multiple engineering teams.
Can evaluate trade-offs and make pragmatic technology decisions.
Understand DevOps and SRE practices for building reliable systems.
Have strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Can influence and mentor others without relying on formal authority.
Have business fluency in German and English.

What can you expect from us?

A dynamic and innovative work environment at the forefront of digital transformation.
Opportunities and training for professional growth and career development.
A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance.
Competitive salary and benefits package including health programs.
The security and prospects of an international, family-owned company that supports sustainability and diversity and has a long-term vision.

jobs.description:
Requistion ID
: 84165

Dentsply Sirona ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Dentalprodukten und -technologien und kann auf mehr als ein Jahrhundert an Innovationen und Dienstleistungen für die Dentalindustrie und Patienten weltweit zurückblicken. Dentsply Sirona entwickelt, produziert und vermarktet ein umfassendes Lösungsangebot, das Produkte für die Zahn- und Mundgesundheit sowie andere medizinische Verbrauchsgüter unter einem starken Portfolio von Weltklassemarken umfasst.

Die Produkte von Dentsply Sirona bieten innovative, qualitativ hochwertige und effektive Lösungen, um die Patientenversorgung zu verbessern und eine bessere und sicherere zahnmedizinische Versorgung zu gewährleisten. Der Hauptsitz von Dentsply Sirona befindet sich in Charlotte, North Carolina. Die Aktien des Unternehmens sind in den Vereinigten Staaten an der NASDAQ unter dem Symbol XRAY notiert. Besuchen Sie www.dentsplysirona.com für weitere Informationen über Dentsply Sirona und seine Produkte.

Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer I (m/w/d), der unser Team verstärkt.
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung bei der Entwicklung und Architektur komplexer Systeme und stellen deren Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sicher. Sie arbeiten über mehrere Epics hinweg, koordinieren Features und etablieren einheitliche Refinement-Prozesse über verschiedene Teams hinweg. Dies ist eine Hybrid-Position, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro von mindestens einem Tag pro Woche erfordert.

Ihre Aufgaben

Technische Umsetzung & Entwicklung

Fördern Sie die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Product-, UX- und Infrastruktur-Teams.
Unterstützen und coachen Sie Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler teamübergreifend als technischer Mentor und Berater.
Führen Sie neue Technologien ein und treiben deren Nutzung voran, um die Effizienz der Softwareentwicklung zu steigern.
Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Incident-Response-Prozesse und sorgen Sie für die Ausfallsicherheit der Systeme.

Projektumfang & Komplexität

Leiten Sie die Umsetzung über mehrere Epics hinweg und koordinieren Sie verschiedene Features, um ein konsistentes Refinement sicherzustellen.
Steuern und begleiten Sie den Epic-Refinement-Prozess zur effektiven Abstimmung mehrerer Features über unterschiedliche Teams hinweg.

Kommunikation & Wirkung

Präsentieren Sie komplexe technische Strategien gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholder-Gruppen.
Fördern Sie die Abstimmung und Einigkeit bei technischen Entscheidungen über mehrere Teams hinweg.

Führung & Weiterentwicklung

Bieten Sie unternehmensweite technische Unterstützung und Mentoring.
Geben Sie die architektonische Ausrichtung vor und unterstützen Sie wichtige technische Entscheidungen.

Ihr Profil

Ausbildung

Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

Berufserfahrung & Qualifikationen

4 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.
Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer technischer Projekte über mehrere Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit mehreren Programmiersprachen wie Golang, C++ oder Flutter/Dart.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Systemarchitektur sowie Skalierbarkeit von Softwarelösungen.
Erfahrung im Mentoring von Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern über verschiedene Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen (Distributed Systems).
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Strategien ist von Vorteil.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten ist ein Plus.
Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Architekturentscheidungen sind wünschenswert.

Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Enterprise Architect EAM - Observability & Operations (m/w/d) bei Atruvia AG
?

Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks.

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland
erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Konversationssicher (B1-B2)

Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse hinsichtlich Datenflüsse, Everything as Code und Operations in cloudnative und Legacy Umfeldern.
Du bringst umfassende Erfahrungen in der architektonischen Umsetzung regulatorischer Standards wie DORA und dem EU AI Act in einem hoch-regulierten Finanzumfeld mit.
Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption und dem Betrieb moderner Plattformen und deren Observability Integration, OpenTelemetry, insbesondere im Umgang mit Kubernetes, GCP, Azure.
Du bringst eine motivierte und agile Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen und Souveränität bei komplexen Aufgabenstellungen mit.

Tätigkeiten

Du gestaltest zusammen mit den umsetzenden Einheiten die übergreifende Architektur der Observabilty und Operationsfähigkeiten.
Du konzipierst dezentrale, übergreifende Architekturen und widmest dich der Verankerung der Observability in unseren Plattformen. Dazu bindest du die föderierte Architekturgovernance für die einzelnen Business-Domänen ein.
Du integrierst die Prinzipien “IaC, Self-healing by design, Runbooks as Code und Policy as Code” ganzheitlich in die gesamte Enterprise-Architektur-Landschaft und erstellst zukunftsfähige Bebauungspläne sowie Migrations-Roadmaps. Eine diesbezügliche Beratungsleistung gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabengebiet.
Du entwickelst Architekturprinzipien und Referenzarchitekturen und verantwortest den strategischen Aufbau von Observability Built-in und run as code in der Atruvia Trusted Tech Foundation (ATTF).

Team

Atruvia ist stolz darauf, Teil der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe zu sein. Diese Zugehörigkeit unterscheidet den Digitalisierungspartner klar von anderen Unternehmen. Denn in einer Genossenschaft zählt jede Stimme. Alle tragen Verantwortung. Dafür braucht es ein stabiles Wertefundament.

Bei Atruvia bedeutet das: füreinander da sein, offen, respektvoll und ehrlich miteinander umgehen, eigenverantwortlich handeln und ergebnisorientierte Entscheidungen treffen.

Über das Unternehmen

Wir sind der Digitalisierungspartner in der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Mit Banking und Informationstechnologie kennen wir uns bestens aus. Unsere speziell auf Banken zugeschnittenen IT-Lösungen und -Leistungen reichen vom Rechenzentrumsbetrieb über unser Bankverfahren bis hin zur App-Entwicklung. Dabei nutzen wir zukunftsweisende Technologien wie Smart Data und schreiben Prozessoptimierung und Regulatorik groß.

Unser Leben wird immer digitaler, schneller und mobiler. Auch die Bankenwelt steckt mitten im Wandel – und damit auch wir als Digitalisierungspartner. Solche Aufbrüche ziehen sich durch unsere Geschichte.

Es ist der Beginn einer neuen Ära: Am 1. September 2021 ist aus der Fiducia & GAD IT AG die Atruvia AG geworden. Damit verbunden ist nicht nur ein neuer Name, sondern auch eine völlig neue strategische Ausrichtung: mit flachen Hierarchien, einem Mehr an Geschwindigkeit und einer nachhaltigen Unterstützung der Kunden im Zuge der Digitalisierung. Das heißt: weg vom IT-Dienstleister hin zum Digitalisierungspartner.

Die Zukunft gehört einfachem und weitgehend automatisiertem Banking. Davon sind wir überzeugt. Standardisierung, effizientere Prozesse und mehr digitale Kundennähe sind wesentliche Faktoren für den Erfolg.

gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Azure-basierte Managed-Services-Lösungen. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass diese von Anfang an sauber in unser Betriebsmodell überführt werden können und agierst als technisches Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.

Was du bei uns machst

Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen im PreSales-Prozess und übersetzt sie in passende Managed-Service-Lösungen auf Basis von Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten.

Du erstellst technische Lösungskonzepte, Aufwandsschätzungen und Betriebsannahmen als Grundlage für Angebote und Business Cases.
Du begleitest Kundengespräche und Workshops, moderierst technische Anforderungsklärung und präsentierst Lösungsvorschläge verständlich auf Entscheiderebene.
Du sorgst für eine strukturierte Übergabe von PreSales an Delivery und Operations.
Du bringst dich aktiv in Weiterentwicklung unseres Managed-Services-Portfolios ein.
Du berätst Kunden zu Sicherheit, Skalierung, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebskosten ihrer Azure-Umgebungen im Kontext eines Managed-Service-Betriebs.

Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Architekturdesign mit Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Betrieb solcher Umgebungen mit.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in technische Architekturen sowie in Betriebsmodelle und Servicekonzepte.
Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung zu Azure-Diensten hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Sicherheit, Skalierung und Betriebszeit mit.
Du bist mit den Grundlagen von Managed Services wie SLAs, Betriebsprozessen, Serviceleveln, Automatisierung und ITSM vertraut.
Du bist mit Azure DevOps, automatisierten Pipelines und Infrastructure as Code sowie deren Bedeutung für einen standardisierten Betrieb vertraut.
Du bist in der Lage, technische PreSales-Meetings zu leiten und Lösungen verständlich gegenüber Kunden und intern zu präsentieren.
Du verstehst dich als Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.
Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und kannst sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.

Negotiable + Benefits

Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code using industry best practices and coding standards.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Software Applications
jobs.description:
At Oxford Instruments Andor we are devoted to accelerating the greatest scientific advancements of our age.

It matters to us that the products we develop make a real difference to our customers and contribute significantly to their research.

We want to deliver differentiated, accessible solutions to the widest possible scientific research and industrial communities.

We are a market leading organisation with a diverse and inclusive environment.

Following an internal promotion we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer- Software Applications will work in the Software team as part of the wider Engineering & Technology Department.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop and support customer-facing Windows desktop applications used to control and run experiments on scientific instrumentation.

Working primarily with C#,.NET and related technologies, you will contribute to software solutions that control hardware, acquire and process scientific data, and provide advanced data visualisation and analysis capabilities.

This is a hands-on software engineering role supporting multiple products and projects across Andor's portfolio.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary teams to deliver robust, maintainable and high-quality software that enables customers to achieve groundbreaking scientific results.

Key Responsibilities

Include

Design, develop, maintain and support customer-facing Windows desktop applications using C# and.NET.
Contribute to the delivery of software across multiple products and projects within the Software Applications portfolio.
Develop software that interfaces with scientific instrumentation and hardware devices for experiment control and automation.
Implement solutions for data acquisition, processing, storage and analysis.
Contribute to the development of data visualisation capabilities, including advanced 3D and 4D rendering and scientific imaging applications.
Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues and customer-reported problems.
Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architecture and technical decision-making.
Write clean, maintainable and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development team.
Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, product managers and domain experts to deliver high-quality solutions.
Support software releases, deployment activities and ongoing product maintenance.
Share technical knowledge and support colleagues through collaboration and peer review.
Occasional travel to other offices and customer sites

The Senior Software Engineer- Software Applications Will Have

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience in delivering commercial software solutions
At least 5 years' experience in commercial software development.
Significant hands-on experience developing applications using C# and.NET.
Proven experience delivering complex software solutions through the full software development lifecycle.
Experience working within Agile software development teams.
Experience developing and supporting commercial desktop software applications.

This permanent position is based at our Belfast headquarters working a hybrid model.

Informal enquiries may be directed to Louise Dooley Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist via email to louise.dooley@oxinst.com

Please apply via this link: Andor Technology - Oxford Instruments Careers (oxinst.com)

Please note on this occasion we are unable to provide sponsorship for visa applicants for this particular post, as such applicants must hold the right to work in the UK to be eligible.

Why Oxford Instruments Andor?

Our company values of being Inclusive, Innovative, Trusted and Purposeful are at the core of everything we do for our customers and our teams.

At Oxford Instruments Andor, our employees are fundamental to our business success and we are delighted to provide a competitive and comprehensive benefits programme with a range of options to suit your lifestyle.

Uk Oxford Instruments Andor Benefits

Oxford Instruments Andor provides employees with a competitive compensation & benefits package to suit your lifestyle.

Health & Wellbeing- Mental Health First Aiders, Employee Assistance Programme (LifeWorks, Babylon and UnMind), Private Medical Insurance with BUPA for you and your dependents, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Personal Accident Insurance. Company sick pay and medical leave, Occupational healthcare Service, 2 days paid leave for volunteering each year
Money & Lifestyle –Pension – employer contributory scheme (6%), Share Incentive Plan, Leave Purchase Scheme, Cycle to Work scheme, Car Salary Exchange Scheme, Tech Purchase scheme. Give as You Earn. Employee discount scheme. Free Parking Onsite.

Work Life Balance – 187.5 holiday hours, 9 customary holidays. Flexible start and finish times, lunchtime finish on Fridays, Enhanced maternity pay, Enhanced paternity pay, Bereavement leave

Oxford Instruments Andor

Oxford Instruments Andor is the global leader in the pioneering and manufacturing of high-performance light measuring solutions, bringing together the latest developments in sensors, electronics, optics and software.

Our ground-breaking low light imaging cameras, spectroscopy solutions and microscopy systems are being used to develop cures for cancer, explore deeper into space and examine clean energy sources.

We are among the world’s most innovative companies in the Photonics industry, measuring light down to a single photon and capturing events occurring within 1 billionth of a second.

We are part of the Imaging & Analysis Division within the wider Oxford Instruments Group. The I&A Division also includes Materials Analysis Group which is comprised of NanoAnalysis, Asylum Research, Plasma Technology, WITec, X-Ray Technology, FemtoTools and Magnetic Resonance. aAt Oxford Instruments, we enable the world’s leading industrial companies and scientific research communities to image, analyse and manipulate materials down to the atomic and molecular level.

Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architecture and technical decision-making.
Write clean, maintainable and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development team.

Occasional travel to other offices and customer sites

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience in delivering commercial software solutions

Significant hands-on experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
Proven experience delivering complex software solutions through the full software development lifecycle.
Experience working within Agile software development teams.
Experience developing and supporting commercial desktop software applications.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Team

The Engineering team at FundApps is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. We’re solving some of the most challenging problems in financial services - we operate in petabytes and milliseconds, not optimising the upload of cat photos. Our clients use our service for multiple hours a day - what we do as engineers has a real life impact on thousands of people across the globe!

Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here.

The Role

As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge.

At FundApps, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, bootstrapped scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code.

We like keeping our tech stack modern and are not afraid to invest to keep it cutting edge! As such we’ve recently completed major projects which included distributing our main rules engine using AWS services, migrated terabytes of data from SQL server to Aurora Postgres, replaced our Single Sign On service with Auth0 and converted our frontend to React.

Our Tech Stack

Back-end: C#
Data storage: PostgreSQL; Amazon storage including Aurora, DynamoDB, S3
Infrastructure: Terraform and AWS, using Fargate, Lambdas, Step functions, and a lot more!
Pipeline: GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, Serverless
Front-end: React, TypeScript

How We Work

FundApps engineers have a lot of freedom to solve problems in a way that achieves our outcomes, and works within our values. You will not be micro-managed - in fact, it's the opposite - you will be expected to take ownership of your work from Day 1. To thrive at FundApps, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, and embrace change as it comes. We value people who take charge of their destiny and help make things better for everyone around them. We release software when it's ready, not on a schedule - our teams deploy multiple times a day.

We work agile, but do not follow any approach blindly - we seek 1% improvements in everything we do, try new things but don't hold to anything too tightly. Fundamentally, we follow a Kanban-inspired approach, but we also take inspiration from Team Topologies, 12-factor, DevOps culture - and all the good agile practices that you have read about. At FundApps we put these practices to work, reflect, and iterate to make sure our practices continue to serve us well.

Our Engineers look after a wide set of products and technical services; we don't strictly follow a micro-services approach, however we are working over time to evolve our codebase and our core technology to be distributed, cloud-native and resource- and cost-effective to power our growth while doing our bit to help FundApps be carbon neutral.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Background:
You are a mid engineer with generalist knowledge of product development concepts (software design, product requirements, work breakdown) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and can apply them to solve well-defined problems independently and with your team. You are comfortable writing code in C#, Java or Python.
Work-with-purpose:
You can articulate the value of your own work in larger projects or team-wide goals. You have the space to own and deliver solutions and are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
Have-courage:
You are comfortable asking for and giving feedback. You help others when needed, and participate in debates, brainstorms, and other team conversations regularly. You build good relationships with your colleagues in Engineering, Product, and the wider company and are able to respectfully challenge each other to understand the problem and come up with the best solutions. As a company, we embrace change and the chance of failure.
Be-transparent:
As a company, we value and aspire for transparency at all levels; you’ll provide work updates to communicate regularly about progress and blockers and reach out for help when needed.
Raise-the-bar:
You seek out opportunities to improve our code, process, and practices; 1% improvements over time improve things for everyone.
Do-more-with-less:
You identify and help implement improvements to processes and standards within the team, seek to optimise our workflow, and share ideas for how to automate manual tasks. As a company we try to minimise meetings (we have meeting-free Wednesdays) and default to asynchronous written communication over long multiple person meetings.

A Few Things To Know Before You Apply
Salary

We are currently hiring across multiple levels and base salary for this role is between £57,000 - £65,000. The final offer will be made based on your experience and your performance during the interview process.

Work Eligibility

We require candidates to have permission to work in the UK without visa sponsorship.

We work hybrid and ask that new FundAppers spend 3 days per week at our shiny London office during their first 6 months, to make the most of getting to know the business and other FundAppers.

After that, our policy is at least 2 days per week in the office to collaborate, connect and make the most of our shared space.

Life at FundApps

🕐 Work/life balance with flexible hybrid working
💚 Wellbeing benefits such as private health insurance, life insurance, a flexible stipend and mental health coaching
💰 Matched pension contribution up to 10%
💰 Peer micro-bonuses through Bonusly
🎓 £1,000 learning budget each year and unlimited professional development leave
💡 Peer-led ‘Brown-bag lunch’ learning sessions and an annual Learning Festival
🚢 25 days holiday leave + an extra day next year if you use it all + an extra day after 3 & 5 years
🧳 5 Years @ FundApps - additional 4 weeks paid holiday leave during your 5th year as a FundApper
👶 26 weeks leave for all new parents regardless of gender, location or family structure
❤️ Volunteering leave
🎁 Birthday off

👩🏾🌈👦🏼🌏👵🏼👳🏽👽

We are proud of the diversity of all FundAppers - it makes us strong. We provide flexibility around religious observances and embrace a variety of cultural celebrations! If you’re looking for a workplace where you can just be yourself, you’re in the right place.

Your Privacy

Any information you submit through our job application process will be used for the purposes of assessing your fit for a role at FundApps. We may also retrieve and store information from your public social media profiles for the same purpose. By applying for this position, you consent to your data being processed in accordance with the FundApps privacy policy.
About FundApps
FundApps is a company powered by experts, with a client community of 1000s and a culture underpinned by ethics. Oh - and we make the best regulatory software so our clients can “get a good night’s sleep now they have FundApps’❃[real client quote]

Many lawyers, ex-regulators, info sec and other experts work for the B Corp that is FundApps. We are all about future-proofing our compliance monitoring and reporting software so we can always monitor the £30trn (and growing) of AuM for the industry’s most active and happy global compliance community [we get top notch NPS + CSAT scores year after year].

Good people, good business, good ethics. We are FundApps.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100960

Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron-based desktop platform. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

Responsibilities

Test automation - approximately 35%: Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end-to-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
Release qualification and automation - approximately 20%: Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release-candidate qualification
Troubleshooting and quality improvement - approximately 15%: Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
Participate in release-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C#, Java, or similar
Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Windows desktop applications
Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application-startup scenarios
Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted-user configurations
Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

The Ideal Candidate

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.

You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web-based products to deliver richer, higher-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.

You will join a new cross-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.
You will collaborate both in person with colleagues in Sheffield and remotely with engineering and partner teams across Autodesk.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

jobs.description:
Location(s): London or Manchester

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

Job Title: Software Engineer

Requistion ID: 120492

Location: London, Manchester or Leeds – Hybrid working offered, with consideration for both full and part-time applicants – please speak to your recruiter about the options

Grade: GG08 – GG13

Are you passionate about working with cutting-edge technology and self-motivated to find innovative solutions to complex challenges as part of a team who help keep the UK safe? Join BAE Systems as an experienced Software Engineer.

As a key member of a Software Engineering team, you’ll be working with our National Security Customers to build systems that support their core mission capabilities. You’ll work as part of empowered, autonomous DevOps teams with regular contact with end-users to flexibly and efficiently understand, design, develop, deploy and maintain applications and services. You’ll be encouraged to identify new ways of solving problems and get to work in a range of different teams across our customer organisations. You’ll be part of the biggest defence company in the UK however we have a startup-like culture nurtured by sports and social clubs, being a safe place to fail, meaning and self-fulfilment over business, and learning from our partners, suppliers, and peers.

We fully embrace DevOps ways of working in our teams, and build a very broad range of capabilities for our customers. We therefore value Engineers who enjoy playing a role in the full delivery lifecycle and are flexible to learn and pick up new technologies and approaches. You’ll be playing a role in identifying the right technologies to use for the job and be supported with training as needed through access to services such as Pluralsight.

Not only will your team be directly making a huge impact upon the systems you work on, you’ll be doing it for an organisation who makes a huge impact to the security of the UK.

About You

You will have experience in many of the following:

Programming in one or more of JavaScript, Java, .Net, Python
Collaboratively designing and building Proof of Concept or Production systems
Source controlling your code with Version Control Systems, for example Git, Mercurial, Perforce
Utilising CI/CD tools, such as Bamboo, Jenkins, TeamCity, Bitbucket, in order to streamline delivery of new features and fixes
Continual testing of code using Automated Testing Frameworks
Ensuring code consistency and quality by utilising static code analysis tools e.g. SonarQube
Team working inside an agile environment e.g. Scrum, Lean, Kanban
Common software design patterns
Using precedent and your own creativity to solve our client's challenges!

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we’ll help you with them

Machine Learning software e.g. Amazon and Azure machine learning, or Google's TensorFlow
Deploying and managing in Cloud Computing such as AWS, MS Azure
Containerisation e.g. Docker, Kubernetes
Relational, document, or graph database systems
Software configuration and deployment e.g. Ansible

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, successful candidates for this role will be required to hold an active eDV before applying for this opportunity.

How We Will Support You

Work-life balance is important; you can work around core hours with flexible and part-time working, and many of our roles include hybrid working enabling a mix of working from home and in the office
You’ll get 25 days holiday a year and the option to buy/sell and carry over from the year before
Our flexible benefits package includes private medical and dental insurance, a competitive pension scheme, cycle to work scheme, taste cards and more
You’ll have a dedicated Career Manager to help you develop your career and guide you on your journey through BAE
You’ll be part of our company bonus scheme
You are welcome to join any/all of our Employee Resource groups. These groups cover everything from gender diversity to mental health and wellbeing.

About Our Team

Our people are what differentiates us, they are resourceful, innovative and dedicated. We have a mix of generalists and specialists and recognise that this diversity contributes to our success. We recognise the benefits of forming teams from a mix of disciplines, which allows us to come up with cutting edge, high quality solutions. Our breadth of work across the Public Sector provides diverse opportunities for our people to develop their careers in new areas of expertise and with new clients.

You’ll be part of a big company, but we try to create a culture that feels like a small one. The work will stretch you and be challenging, but we encourage a healthy work-life balance. Most of all, we know teams who work well together also perform well. We’ll do everything we can to ensure you have fun at work, and in social activities outside of it whether that’s virtually or in person, as conditions allow.

We have a rich history of working within National Security. In fact, we have over 40 years’ experience of delivering advice and solutions to our customers in this sector, supporting them in carrying out their vital missions.

Why BAE Systems?

This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.

Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence

We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day.

By embracing technology, we can interact, collaborate and create together, even when we’re working remotely from one another. Hybrid Working allows for increased flexibility in when and where we work, helping us to balance our work and personal life more effectively, and enhance well-being.

Inclusion is integral to the success of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence. We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential.

Division overview: Capabilities

At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector.

As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns (Manchester)
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
Generative AI and intelligent systems experience — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
AI-native delivery leadership — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
Transformation and platform modernization leadership — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
A maverick streak with enterprise judgment — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
Financial services domain knowledge — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
Technical thought leadership — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

What We Offer

A genuine mandate to innovate — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
Executive visibility and strategic influence — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
The intersection of depth and breadth — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
A culture that rewards curiosity — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Solution Architect to support the Strategic Energy Planning (SEP) and Strategy & Policy (S&P) functional areas.

This role is accountable for the design and delivery of end-to-end solution architectures that enable strategic decision-making, policy development, and energy system transformation.

The Solution Architect Will

Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance platforms and solutions supporting energy modelling, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Ensure alignment between business strategy, policy objectives, and technology delivery.
Work across multiple domains to enable integrated, enterprise-wide capabilities.
The architect will work closely with data scientists, energy modellers, delivery teams, Business Analysts and business stakeholders to ensure the platform enables complex scenario simulations (e.g., decarbonisation pathways, demand forecasting, market simulations) while maintaining extensibility, performance, and governance.

This role is Hybrid & can be based from Wokingham or Warwick. We continue to support flexible working where applicable.

This role is designated as requiring a National Security Vetting (NSV) clearance. You will usually need to have been a resident in the UK for the last five years to apply for the required level of clearance.

Key Accountabilities

Own end-to-end architecture designs across SEP and S&P capabilities, ensuring alignment to enterprise architecture principles, NESO1, and strategic roadmaps, building comprehensive knowledge of the various technology components and the business capabilities they provide.
Confidently engage with stakeholders across the Programme, being empathetic to their needs and challenges, whilst being able to articulate pragmatic solutions in a calm and professional manner.
Work closely with other DD&T colleagues (including Delivery Partners and Suppliers), actively participating in meetings and workshops to help drive solution related conversations to meaningful conclusions.
Map Solution Requirements to Solution Designs, ensuring desired outcomes are supported, and the implications of solutions being implemented are considered from a technology, people and process perspective.
Ensure architectural artefacts produced (including Solution Options and Recommendations, Solution Intents, and High-Level Designs) are approved/endorsed through appropriate Architecture Governance processes, working collaboratively with Integration, Security, Platform and other SMEs to deliver comprehensive solution collateral.
Collateral produced must be written in an easily digestible way, which is fit for purpose of the audience it is aimed at.
Define innovative solutions which consider non-functional requirements (e.g. Security, Performance, Reliability, Scalability, Stability, Data Archival, and Disaster Recovery).
Provide Support and Guidance to Delivery and Test teams to ensure any changes necessary are validated in the context of the wider solution footprint.
Work closely with Team members and other Solution Architects to define, document and resolve technical dependencies and blockers to achieve business value.
Align to strategy, identifying transitional and tactical solutions when strategic options are not defined or available in each timeframe.
Provide specialist technical support across all solutions.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK by the start of employment. Visa sponsorship may not be available for this role and will be considered in line with business requirements.

About You

Technical Expertise

Strong experience in designing large-scale data and analytics platforms
Expertise in cloud architectures (preferably Azure, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Fabric, etc.)
Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, distributed systems)
Proficiency in data modelling, especially time-series and simulation datasets
Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures

Energy Domain Knowledge

Understanding of energy systems (electricity markets, renewables, grid operations, or oil & gas)
Experience with energy modelling tools or frameworks (e.g., PLEXOS, TIMES, PyPSA, EnergyPLAN, or similar)
Familiarity with scenario modelling, forecasting, and optimization techniques

Analytics and Modelling

Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning, or optimization approaches
Experience enabling data science workflows (e.g., notebooks, MLOps)
Knowledge of Python, R, or similar for modelling environments

Soft Skills

Excellent problem-solving and systems-thinking abilities
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive architectural decisions

About You

We’re looking for someone who:

Is passionate about enabling net zero and energy system transformation
Has experience delivering complex, cross-domain architectures
Can bridge the gap between strategy, policy, and technology
Has strong experience in data-led platforms and decision-support systems
Is a confident communicator who can engage at business, technical and executive levels

What You'll Get

A competitive salary of circa £72,000 - £80,000 dependent on experience and capabilityAs well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus of up to 15% of your salary for stretch performance, 28 days annual leave as standard, and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%.

Benefits

NESO's flexible benefits programme provides you with more flexibility around your health, lifestyle and protection benefits, here's just a few available:

Flexible Bank Holidays & Holiday Trading
Additional Birthday Day Off
Cycle to Work Scheme, Retail & Gym Discounts
Private Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance & Personal Accident Insurance

About Us

At the National Energy System Operator (NESO), we play a vital role in tackling climate change and securing Great Britain's energy future. We already operate the world's fastest decarbonising electricity system and are working towards our ambition to run it carbon-free for a short period this year - provided the market supplies electricity exclusively from renewable sources. Alongside this, we provide expert advice to government on how to deliver a clean power system by 2030.

In autumn 2024, the Electricity System Operator (ESO) transitioned to become NESO - an independent, expert public corporation with a whole-system view across electricity, gas, and hydrogen. NESO operates independently and transparently, always acting in the best interests of all energy users.

Licensed and regulated by Ofgem, we make impartial decisions that balance sustainability, affordability and security. Our organisation is fully independent from government, the regulator and all commercial interests, with a clear focus on system-wide benefit, long term thing and public value.

The time to deliver is now. Join the energy transformation and help shape the future.

Your energy. Our future. Together

National Energy System Operator (NESO) recognises the potential of bright and talented individuals, and we encourage you to join us as Great Britain’s energy system undergoes an ambitious, exciting, and vital transformation. Together with industry, we are creating a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

More Information

This role closes at 23:59, on the day before date shown above, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

Research shows that some people may hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At NESO, we believe potential comes in many forms and we're committed to a fair, inclusive recruitment

We're committed to building a workforce that represents the communities we serve, and a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential. O zespole i projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego rozwiązanie oparte o Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
, w którym system CRM stanowi kluczowy element większego ekosystemu integrującego różne procesy i systemy biznesowe. To projekt o mocno developerskim charakterze. Na co dzień będziesz rozwijać zarówno warstwę kliencką, jak i serwerową Dynamics 365 CRM, tworząc własne rozszerzenia, logikę biznesową oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi. Zespół pracuje zgodnie z dobrymi praktykami inżynierskimi, dbając o jakość kodu, czytelność rozwiązań i ich dalszy rozwój.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

rozwijasz Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM od strony developerskiej, a nie wyłącznie konfiguracyjnej,
pracujesz zarówno z TypeScript, jak i C#/.NET, rozwijając logikę po stronie klienta i serwera,
tworzysz pluginy, customizacje oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi,

masz realny wpływ na jakość rozwiązań i sposób ich implementacji.

rozwój client-side customizacji w Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM z wykorzystaniem TypeScript, w tym logiki formularzy, walidacji oraz obsługi elementów interfejsu,
rozwój pluginów C#/.NET odpowiedzialnych za logikę biznesową i customizacje encji,
implementację logiki obsługującej zdarzenia Create, Update i Delete,
rozwój integracji pomiędzy Dynamics 365 CRM a systemami zewnętrznymi z wykorzystaniem Azure Service Bus,
współpracę przy wdrożeniach aplikacji z wykorzystaniem wewnętrznych procesów CI/CD oraz narzędzi opartych o Power Apps,
dbanie o jakość kodu oraz stosowanie dobrych praktyk programistycznych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz komercyjne doświadczenie w rozwoju Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM,
bardzo dobrze znasz C#/.NET oraz TypeScript / JavaScript,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu client-side customizacji formularzy Dynamics 365 CRM,
rozwijałeś/aś pluginy Dynamics 365 CRM oraz logikę biznesową po stronie serwera,
masz doświadczenie w integracji systemów z wykorzystaniem API lub kolejek komunikatów,
potrafisz pracować samodzielnie i brać odpowiedzialność za rozwijane rozwiązania,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z Azure Service Bus,
znajomość usług Microsoft Azure,
doświadczenie z Power Platform (Power Apps lub Power Automate),
znajomość procesów CI/CD oraz pracy z Git.
