Do you care about stability, scalability, debugging difficult production issues, and making aviation software safer and more reliable? Then you might be the next person to join the ForeFlight / Jeppesen ForeFlight team.

We are seeking an experienced C# / C++ developer for Windows and iOS for our team in Poland who enjoys working in a diverse team of highly capable engineers

About The Role

As a C# / C++ developer at ForeFlight / Jeppesen ForeFlight, you will work mainly on a Windows EFB application, while also contributing to a middleware SDK/library used by client applications across platforms, including Windows and iOS.

Typical Tasks And Responsibilities Include

Software development of the Windows EFB application

Working with C#, UWP/XAML and C++ components
Debugging issues across managed and native code
Contributing to content delivery SDK/library code
Supporting platform adapter work for Windows, WinRT/UWP and iOS
Working with HTTP/REST integrations, content download flows, certificates and authentication
Improving error handling, retries, logging and diagnostics
Collaborating with developers, test engineers and stakeholders across global teams
Supporting automated tests, CI builds and release packaging
Proactively working with test engineers to ensure product reliability and safety

Who are you?

Role

Educational background in a relevant technical field, e.g. software engineering, computer science, electronics and telecommunications, data science, or related discipline.
5+ years of strong software development experience with C# and C++14 or newer
Communicative English and ability to collaborate with global stakeholders
Experience with Windows client development
Experience with UWP / XAML; WPF experience is also valuable
Experience with Visual Studio, MSBuild, NuGet and Windows SDK

Good debugging skills across C#, C++ and native/managed boundaries
Experience with unit and integration testing
Experience with HTTP/REST integrations, error handling, retries and logging
Basic understanding of certificates, authentication flows and secure storage
You try to understand the problem, not only implement the requested change

SDK/library development experience

iOS exposure: Swift, Objective-C / Objective-C++, Xcode

Experience in open source or multi-repo development

Job Description

Division: Group Business Solutions (GBS)

Your career opportunity

Join our Group Business Solutions (GBS) division, where we design and sustain IT solutions for financial market securities. Be part of a dynamic, collaborative team in a fast-evolving environment, shaping the future of financial technology.
Ready to make an impact?

We’re seeking a skilled and proactive Expert Engineer eager to broaden their expertise and drive impactful improvements across our solutions. You’ll tackle complex problems and help shape our delivery, working in a collaborative environment that supports growth, fosters innovation and strengthens our alignment with business needs.
Your Day-to-day Mission

Lead the design, architecture, and development of technical and functional solutions, owning complex features and collaborating with senior developers and cross‑functional teams to deliver robust, scalable systems. Provide expert input to technical decisions and support junior colleagues in resolving medium‑to‑high‑complexity issues.
Contribute and actively shape ideation workshops by providing expert insights and recommending enhancements to improve product functionality and user experience
Drive the definition, estimation, and validation of complex technical requirements, proactively influencing planning accuracy and enabling predictable, high‑quality feature delivery across teams.
Ensure the stability and reliability of production applications by independently leading technical investigations, implementing durable fixes, and guiding peers in troubleshooting.
Lead the creation and improvement of design documentation for medium‑to‑high‑complexity changes, ensuring technical clarity and alignment with architectural standards while contributing to stronger design practices across the team.
Drive the adoption and evolution of best practices and coding standards to ensure high code quality, while leading and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the team.

Hands-on experience as a software engineer (at least 5 years) .
Advanced understanding of software related system designs and technology stacks.
Solid knowledge of solution development and design principles.
Ability to interpret business requirements, assess their technical implications, and help translate them into well‑scoped, practical technical solutions.

Strong command of English, both spoken and written.

Mainframe: PL/I or Cobol, DB2, MQ, CICS
Nice to have:
Java / .NET / APIs / Integration
Azure, Kafka, event-driven architecture
IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, JDK, Javac/Java commands, Maven, Gradle, IDE environments, JUnit, Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, VisualVM, JFR, Kubernetes, Azure Cloud, AWS, GCP, VPC/VNet, CLI, Visual Studio, Oracle, CSS, SSIS, APIs, MQ Series, Linux, Togaf, CoBit.

Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
A strong sense of ownership and accountability in your work
Proactive attitude with a structured and solution-oriented approach Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment
Clear and effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Coaching and mentoring capabilities, with a willingness to support team growth
A continuous learning mindset and drive for improvement  Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
Knowledge of Agile methodologies.

Work outside of business hours is sometimes required as launches in production are generally carried out after 5PM or on Saturday as well as watch duty during nights and weekends.

Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance or contract arrangements for this role.

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.
Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear

The Group Business Solutions (GBS) division ensures the competitiveness of Euroclear by delivering reliable and sustainable IT solutions for the financial securities markets. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

jobs.description:
Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen
2× live coding in your preferred language
1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Timeline:
Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your
expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.
After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths
and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume
along with a brief cover letter
that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.”
In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

Your role and the problem space you were working in
The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them
The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer with German (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma wartość tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy. Tworzymy rozwiązania, które działają w praktyce – są skalowalne, stabilne i projektowane z myślą o długofalowym wykorzystaniu. Łączymy wiedzę techniczną z doświadczeniem projektowym zdobywanym w branżach przemysłowych i technologicznych. Pracujemy w międzynarodowym środowisku, stawiając na jakość, współpracę i ciągłe doskonalenie.

Projekt realizowany jest dla międzynarodowej firmy technologicznej z branży automotive, rozwijającej zaawansowaną platformę SaaS wspierającą sprzedaż i obsługę klientów. Rozwiązanie integruje procesy marketingowe, sprzedażowe i obsługę posprzedażową w jednym systemie, wspierając organizacje w zarządzaniu relacjami z klientami i optymalizacji procesów biznesowych.

Dlaczego warto rozważyć ten projekt?

To propozycja dla osób, które chcą pracować nad rozwojem skalowalnego produktu SaaS, wykorzystywanego w codziennej pracy przez organizacje na wielu rynkach. Projekt jest w fazie intensywnego rozwoju, co oznacza realny wpływ na architekturę, technologie oraz kierunek rozwoju platformy. Pracujesz w środowisku fullstackowym — zarówno przy backendzie (Java), jak i frontendzie (TypeScript), mając wpływ na cały cykl życia produktu. W projekcie wykorzystujesz język niemiecki w komunikacji z interesariuszami, jednocześnie pracując w szerszym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji webowej w modelu fullstack (Java + TypeScript),
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej po stronie backendu i frontendu,
projektowanie i rozwój API oraz integrację systemu z zewnętrznymi rozwiązaniami,
pracę z technologiami backendowymi (Java, Spring Boot) oraz bazami danych (MySQL, Elasticsearch),
rozwój warstwy frontendowej z wykorzystaniem TypeScript oraz frameworków takich jak Vue.js,
analizę wymagań biznesowych i ich przekład na rozwiązania techniczne,
dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez testy jednostkowe i integracyjne oraz udział w code review,
diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych w środowisku produkcyjnym,
współpracę z zespołem produktowym i interesariuszami biznesowymi,
udział w procesach Agile oraz rozwój i usprawnianie praktyk zespołowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji fullstack,
pracujesz z językiem Java oraz frameworkiem Spring Boot,
masz doświadczenie w pracy z TypeScript oraz frameworkami frontendowymi (np. Vue.js, React lub Angular),
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu API oraz integracji systemów,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych (np. MySQL) oraz rozwiązaniami typu Elasticsearch,
masz doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku SaaS lub przy rozwoju produktów,
znasz metodyki Agile/Scrum i pracowałeś/-aś w zespołach developerskich,
posługujesz się językiem niemieckim na poziomie minimum B2,
posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie minimum B2,
dbasz o jakość kodu i stosujesz dobre praktyki programistyczne.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z AWS,
doświadczenie w pracy z CI/CD (np. GitLab CI/CD),
doświadczenie w pracy z architekturą mikroserwisową,
doświadczenie w pracy z produktami CRM lub systemami sprzedażowymi.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku produktowym,
udział w rozwoju platformy wykorzystywanej na wielu rynkach,
możliwość pracy zdalnej,
realny wpływ na rozwój produktu i technologii,
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem technologicznym.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i zobaczymy, jak pasuje do tej roli i projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – luźna, partnerska rozmowa (ok. 40–60 minut), żeby lepiej się poznać, porozmawiać o Twojej drodze zawodowej, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.
Krótkie spotkanie językowe (online) – około 10–15 minutowa rozmowa z native speakerem, podczas której zweryfikujemy Twoją znajomość języka niemieckiego.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare inom AML
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Som Senior .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i Skandias AML-team (Anti-Money Laundering), där ni utvecklar systemstöd för att förebygga penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism – ett affärskritiskt uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Arbetet fokuserar på backendutveckling i .NET/C# och eventdriven arkitektur i en säkerhetskänslig miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet.

Du utvecklar och optimerar integrationer mot andra system, samarbetar nära teamet genom exempelvis par- och mobbprogrammering och bidrar till kontinuerlig förbättring av kod, arbetssätt och lösningar.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabila lösningar är avgörande. Du är van att arbeta i affärskritiska systemmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och implementation till vidareutveckling och förbättring.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.

Du har även ett intresse för att ligga i framkant inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, till exempel genom verktyg som GitHub Copilot.

Du har erfarenhet av

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vad händer nu?

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Du kan läsa mer om vår process här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stephan Mannerfelt på stephan.mannerfelt@skandia.se

Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Madelene Skogh, på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. What You Will Do

Develop reusable platform services, architectural patterns, and reference implementations.
Identify opportunities for platform convergence and reuse across BDP, Building Automation, and Digital Energy teams.
Translate strategic architectural direction into working software and deployable infrastructure.
Design secure, resilient, observable, scalable, and cost-effective Azure solutions.
Establish patterns for identity, networking, data, integration, APIs, messaging, storage, compute, and multitenancy.
Design cloud-to-edge architectures for building and energy-management applications.
Enable AI workloads using appropriate Azure services, containers, Kubernetes, model endpoints, data platforms, and security controls.
Create infrastructure-as-code modules, automated deployment pipelines, and operational standards.
Build prototypes and production foundations rather than limiting the role to diagrams or review boards.
Evaluate tradeoffs involving security, performance, reliability, data sovereignty, latency, maintainability, and cost.
Mentor architects and developers across the global organization.

Extensive experience architecting and building production solutions on Microsoft Azure.

Apply today, we review applications on an ongoing basis!

Our client is looking for a System Developer to support the continued growth of its operations in Poland. This expansion has created an increased need for technical support, system integrations, and development, particularly as the company continues to establish itself in the Polish market. As Poland is still a relatively new market for the company, fluency in Polish is essential to ensure clear communication and excellent customer support.

In this role, you will have a central position in a close-knit development team, where you will help build solutions from the ground up and further develop existing systems.
You will work closely with the end customer, giving you a deep understanding of the business’s needs and how the systems are used in practice. This also means short decision-making paths and close dialogue with users, allowing you to quickly see the impact of what you develop.

An important part of the work involves systems connected to GIS (geographic information systems), where data is used, for example, to analyze environmental changes, water levels, and other factors that affect forestry. From a technical perspective, the role primarily involves backend development in C#/.NET, often in cloud-based Microsoft Azure environments.

Has professional experience with C#/.NET

Experience with or an interest in GIS systems
Professional experience from the forest industry
Experience with Python and/or C/C++

Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.

Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious AI & Digital Systems Architect to define and govern the architecture required to integrate artificial intelligence into industrial products, engineering workflows, and business processes.

The role connects control systems, edge and cloud platforms, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and governed data foundations to create scalable, secure, reusable, and production-ready AI capabilities. The architect translates business and engineering needs into end-to-end solution blueprints, guides solutions from experimentation to operational deployment, and ensures that model quality, explainability, cybersecurity, human oversight, lifecycle governance, and measurable value are engineered into every AI-enabled capability.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and govern end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled products, digital solutions, and engineering workflows across OT, edge, cloud, data, and enterprise environments.
Establish AI architecture standards, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and best practices for scalable and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases that create measurable business impact.
Drive the integration of AI across engineering, operations, service, and digital processes, from concept and proof of concept through industrialization and adoption.

Define data, knowledge, and platform architectures leveraging technologies such as data platforms, lakehouses, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and digital twins.
Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices covering deployment, monitoring, testing, evaluation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Ensure AI solutions meet requirements for security, privacy, reliability, explainability, compliance, and responsible AI governance.
Design scalable integration patterns, APIs, and data flows connecting OT systems, engineering tools, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Act as the technical authority for AI and digital systems architecture, mentoring teams and aligning strategy across software, data, cloud, cybersecurity, and business functions.

Your background

PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in software, systems, data, AI/ML, industrial automation, or other mission-critical digital platforms.
Strong expertise in enterprise and systems architecture, software lifecycle management, data architectures, AI/ML engineering, and industrial automation.
Proven track record of defining end-to-end architectures and delivering AI-enabled solutions from concept and prototyping to scalable production environments.

Deep understanding of AI engineering practices including MLOps/LLMOps, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, explainability, and responsible AI.

Proficiency in Python, modern AI/ML frameworks, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP; familiarity with TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4, cybersecurity, data protection, regulatory compliance, and engineering tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or PSCAD is considered an advantage.

Vi söker dig som har lång erfarenhet av Business Central, gärna med kombinationen av funktionell konsulting och lösningsarkitektur. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.

jobs.description:
Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!

We seek a new colleague to join our talented Technology team based at our Copenhagen office.

At AutoProff, we believe great technology drives great experiences - and we’re just getting started. We’re on a mission to transform the way vehicles are traded across Europe, and we need curious and driven new colleagues to help us do it.

As our new Software Engineer, you’ll join a cross-functional team focused on the Fulfillment & FinTech domain, where we build and evolve critical post-trade services in a B2B environment. Our team owns key capabilities such as logistics orchestration, transport partner integrations, payment touchpoints, invoicing visibility, and claims handling, ensuring seamless and transparent operations after a transaction is completed. Working closely with product, operations, and external partners, you’ll help design and deliver robust, scalable solutions that connect multiple systems and stakeholders, directly impacting the efficiency and reliability of our platform for customers across Europe.

We foster a developer-friendly culture where innovation isn’t just encouraged, it’s expected. You’ll have access to modern, AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and streamline your daily work. We host hackathons to explore new tech, ideas and tools, and our internal developer forums are open spaces for discussing architecture, new technologies, and tough engineering challenges. Whether building or learning, there's always room to experiment and grow.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Work in a dynamic and international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code using engineering best practices and design patterns.
Drive a culture of “you build it - you own it” - mentality
Identify and act on areas for your own personal development
Mentor and coach co-workers on topics that you master.

The need-to-have skills

Proven ability to thrive in environments that value adaptability, shared ownership, and continuous improvement
Experience working with .NET and C#
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, distributed systems and event-driven architecture.
Experience with relational databases or No-SQL databases
Good communication skills and fluency in business English (spoken and written)
Open towards and able to quickly learn new technologies
Ability to troubleshoot problems, debug and suggest solutions

The nice-to-have skills

Experience working with AWS Infrastructure or other cloud providers, especially containerization and serverless computing.
Experience with RESTful APIs

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded 2013 in Denmark with the aim to digitise B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

In August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialised pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialise in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitisation and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. Shape the core platforms that move energy markets. As a software Engineer in Trading Solutions, you’ll build high‑performance .NET services that power trading, post‑trade, and data flows for a business with deep roots in energy markets and a fast‑growing renewables footprint. Design and implement high‑throughput services and APIs in modern .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) for trading and post‑trade workflows.

jobs.description:
Vi skalerer platformen bag Danmarks største online apotek til næste niveau — cloud-native infrastruktur, GitOps og AI. Vil du være med til at forme rejsen?

Om os

Apoteka udvikler og driver platformen bag Apopro - Danmarks største online apotek. Platformen forbinder apotekersystem, lager, logistik og webshop end-to-end.

Vores mål er at gøre medicin og sundhedsrådgivning lettere tilgængelig for alle. Vi måler succes både på vækst og på den forskel, vi gør for mennesker og samfund.

Om rollen

Du bliver en del af vores Pharm Engineering-team, der fokuserer på de centrale processer i apotekersystemet og ordrebehandling: ordrer, recepter, lager, tilskud og integrationer til sundhedssektoren.

Som DevOps engineer er du grundlæggende software engineer, men med et særligt speciale i automatiseringer, infrastruktur, og i moderniseringen af vores arkitektur. Du får en central rolle i at drive, sikre og videreudvikle den platform og cloud-infrastruktur, som resten af udviklingen bygger på.

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle punkter nedenfor for at søge — vi ser både på meget erfarne ansøgere, og på dem med et par års erfaring, som er sultne efter at udvikle sig videre ind i rollen. Har du mindre erfaring på nogle af de konkrete områder, men er hurtig til at lære nyt, nysgerrig og tror på, at du vil passe godt ind i teamet, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig alligevel.

Dine opgaver:

De daglige opgaver kredser sig primært omkring:
Drive og videreudvikle vores Kubernetes-platform: deploye, opgradere og operere clusters.
Automatisk skalering (autoscaling) af VMs og containere baseret på load.
Infrastructure as Code med Kubernetes samt GitOps, GitHub Actions og CI/CD.
Automatisere manuelt arbejde frem for at akkumulere manuelle driftsopgaver — herunder med AI-værktøjer, hvor det giver mening.
Være med til at forbedre vores udviklingsproces med AI-værktøjer og sætte de rette guard rails omkring dem.
Observability og monitorering for at forbedre både performance og stabilitet.
Have blik for omkostninger og effektivitet (FinOps) — ikke kun oppetid.
Sikkerhed: håndtering af secrets, netværkssegmentering og kryptering, både at-rest og in-transit.
Bidrage til teamets kvalitet igennem team-ritualer, reviews, tests og refactoring.

Vi er i gang med en større modernisering af vores cloud platform, og her spiller du en nøglerolle:
Migrere databaser — mellem forskellige hosts og i visse tilfælde fra én teknologi til en anden.
Migrere fra .NET Framework 4.x til moderne .NET 10: SDK-style projekter og modernisering af afhængigheder.
Dekomponere monolitter og store databaser til mindre services og databaser.
Andre opgaver på platformens udvikling.

Hvad vi leder efter:

En engageret og nysgerrig platformsudvikler, med en god portion gå-på-mod og stærke evner.
En team-player, der er service-minded og deler gavmildt ud af sin viden — både over for kolleger i og uden for eget team.
God erfaring med Kubernetes operations: deploy, opgradering og drift af clusters.
Godt kendskab til Linux, netværk og security groups/firewalls (private netværk, egress control, NAT/edge). Kendskab til Windows Server er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Erfaring med moderne cloud-native platforme og infrastructure-as-code værdsættes højt.
Gode evner i .NET, C#, databaser og API'er er et plus, men ikke et hårdt krav — du er stadig udvikler i bund og grund. Andre teknologier i vores stak er bl.a. SQL Server, Redis, RabbitMq, Elastic og uCommerce/Umbraco.
En automatiseringsfokuseret tilgang: du løser tilbagevendende opgaver med automatisering frem for manuelt arbejde
Interesse for at være med til at forme, hvordan vi som team bruger AI-værktøjer i udviklingsprocessen, herunder de guard rails der skal til for at gøre det sikkert og ansvarligt.
En pragmatisk og inkrementel tilgang: du kan modernisere løbende, sideløbende med roadmap og feature-udvikling — ikke ved at fryse alt andet.
Kritisk tænkende og interesseret i fortsat forbedring af både hvad vi laver og hvordan vi laver det. Du kan både løse komplekse opgaver selvstændigt og hjælpe resten af teamet med at forbedre vores system.

Vi tilbyder:

En vigtig rolle i et firma hvor din stemme kan høres.
En spændende arbejdsplads med høj medarbejdertilfredshed, hvor de mange fagligheder i pharma, e-commerce, warehouse, og tech, arbejder sammen for en fælles sag.
Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både personligt og fagligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med reference til Engineering Manager, Jacob Bonde Larsen. Din arbejdsplads vil hovedsageligt være i Greve, men med fleksibilitet til at arbejde nogle dage på vores lokation i København eller hjemme.

We are growing our engineering team at Trustpilot and are looking to welcome a Software Engineer I into the Trust Tech department!
You will join a cross-functional team with full ownership of our products and codebase, where you will take part in every step of the development process, from ideation to maintenance. This is a place where you can grow as an individual, learn from senior mentors, and have a real influence on the direction of our projects.
About the team: 

You will be joining a brand new team being built within the Trust Tech department, focusing specifically on businesses.
The team is responsible for building and maintaining automated systems that enforce Trustpilot’s terms of use for businesses. This includes developing systems for automatic detection, enforcement of misuse, and internal investigation tools.
This work is vital to maintaining Trust and Transparency on the platform. To achieve this, we collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Ops, and ML Ops to build sophisticated automated architectures that integrate detection models and robustly scale our misuse enforcement.
What you’ll be doing:

Work in a cross-functional “full ownership” team alongside Product, Design, and Data Science.
Implement and release new features with a focus on backend stability and scalability.
Help build solutions to handle high-volume data processing for fraud detection.
Maintain and improve the internal tooling frontends (React) used for investigations.
Troubleshoot existing software, squash bugs, and learn how to optimize database performance.
Participate in technical discussions and learn best practices for Infrastructure as Code.
Collaborate with Data Scientists to support the integration of detection models.

Who you are:

Experience in full-stack web development (commercial experience or a strong portfolio), with a focus on backend systems.
Solid knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
Solid understanding of backend development with Node.js.
Understanding of SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) database concepts.
Familiarity with component-based frontend development (ideally React).
Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP.
A friendly, helpful personality, open to giving and receiving feedback constructively.
Ambitious and passionate about your work, motivated to continually improve.

Nice to have:

Interest in Applied AI and how it integrates with backend engineering.

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, Lambda, SNS, SQS, CloudFormation), GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub), Docker, Terraform
Backend: Node.js, Serverless Framework
Database: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, BigQuery
Frontend: React, Next.js, CSS Modules
Tools: GitHub Actions

Find more on: http://stackshare.io/trustpilot 
What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. jobs.title: Network Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay effective under pressure during critical incidents and escalations
Client Orientation & Communication
Accountability
Adapting & responding to chang
Teamwork & cooperation

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation
:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500

It's more than a job

As Senior Software Engineer – Power Platform & Automation Consulting, you combine strong software engineering capabilities with trusted business consulting. You identify strategic automation opportunities, advise senior stakeholders and translate complex business challenges into secure, scalable and user-centric solutions based on Microsoft Power Platform and the wider Microsoft technology stack.

You take end-to-end ownership—from discovery, process analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.

In addition, you act as an enabler for business and functional units by helping non-technical stakeholders understand automation opportunities, make informed decisions and realize measurable business value.

Success is measured by the quality, reliability, adoption and business impact of the solutions delivered, as well as your ability to build trusted relationships across business and IT.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Act as a trusted technology and automation consultant for business leaders and senior management.
Identify, assess and prioritise automation opportunities together with business and functional units.
Facilitate discovery workshops and translate business needs into clear requirements, solution concepts, roadmaps and value cases.
Explain technical capabilities, constraints, risks and architectural decisions in clear business language to non-IT audiences.
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain enterprise-ready solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio.
Extend Power Platform solutions with Microsoft Azure services, APIs, custom connectors and professional-code components where appropriate.
Build robust integrations with Microsoft 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, enterprise applications and approved data sources.
Apply sound software engineering practices, including modular design, source control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and technical documentation.
Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, information security, data protection, governance and application lifecycle management requirements.
Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, decision papers, demonstrations and management updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Take ownership of the complete solution lifecycle, including production support, performance monitoring, incident analysis and continuous optimisation.
Collaborate effectively with product teams, architects, business analysts, security teams, platform administrators and citizen developers across a global organisation.
Coach business teams and citizen developers on solution design, platform capabilities, development standards and responsible automation practices.
Contribute reusable components, patterns, standards and best practices to strengthen the organisation’s Power Platform and automation capabilities.
Evaluate new Microsoft technologies and recommend their use based on business value, technical fit, security and maintainability.

Your Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Informatics or a comparable discipline; equivalent professional experience is also welcome.
Several years of professional experience in software engineering, solution development or enterprise automation.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio.
Experience extending low-code solutions through Azure services, REST APIs, custom connectors, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, .NET, Power Fx or comparable technologies.
Sound knowledge of software architecture, integration patterns, data modelling, security concepts and application lifecycle management.
Practical experience with source control, automated testing and CI/CD, for example using Git and Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Proven consulting experience in analysing complex business challenges and advising senior management or executive-level stakeholders.
Ability to connect business strategy, process improvement and technology, and to translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Excellent presentation, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with confidence in leading workshops and management discussions.
Excellent analytical, structured problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly and convincingly to non-technical audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
Experience working in global, cross-functional and agile teams.
Strong ownership mentality, customer orientation and ability to manage several priorities independently.
Knowledge of Power Platform governance, security, environment strategy, licensing and Centre of Excellence practices is a strong advantage.
Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications are an advantage.
Experience in logistics, supply chain management or another process-intensive enterprise environment is an advantage.
Experience with process mining, RPA, AI-enabled automation, OCR or document-processing technologies is an advantage.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.
You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
Hands-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
A working understanding of distributed, service-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Senior ServiceNow Architect to build and extend CPQ and quote-to-order solutions within ServiceNow's CRM and Industry Workflows portfolio, working across Sales and Order Management (SOM), Customer Service Management (CSM) and the Logik.ai-powered CPQ capability.

Design, develop and configure solutions across Sales and Order Management, CSM and CPQ, including product catalogue, quoting, pricing logic and order orchestration.

Support scoping and estimation of CPQ and AI workstreams.

The position requires working from the office in Madrid 2-3 days per week.

Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — required.
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) — required.

4+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform development. Non-negotiable.
Demonstrable delivery experience in ServiceNow CRM and Industry Workflows — Sales and Order Management, CSM, Product Catalogue or Order Management.

Technical Skills — Required

Strong ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript, GlideRecord, server-side and client-side scripting, script includes, business rules, ACLs.
Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, scoped application development.
REST/SOAP API integration, authentication patterns (OAuth/JWT), transform maps and data import.
Now Assist / AI Agent Studio: configuring AI agents and skills, prompt design, grounding AI in platform data.
UI development: UI Builder / Now Experience or Service Portal.
Automated Test Framework (ATF) and source control (Git) / update-set discipline.

Technical skills — desired (ramp-up areas, not entry filters)

Logik.ai experience — configuration and solving engine, pricing logic, composable/API-first implementation patterns. Rare in the market; treated as a strong differentiator.
CPQ domain knowledge: product configuration, constraint-based rules, pricing and discounting models, quote-to-cash processes.
CPQ experience on other platforms (Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ/Callidus, Conga, PROS, Tacton).
Agentic AI patterns beyond the platform: MCP-based integrations, multi-agent orchestration.
Industry exposure to complex-product sectors: manufacturing, high-tech, telecommunications, industrial, medical devices.

Strong ownership and accountability for technical quality and delivery.
Able to communicate with commercial stakeholders (sales, pricing, finance) as well as technical teams.
Analytical mindset; able to decompose complex commercial rules into structured, maintainable logic.
Consultative — challenges requirements constructively and presents options with pros, cons and risks.
Comfortable working in a fast-evolving product area with limited established precedent.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

Early role in building a CPQ and AI practice on a newly established, high-demand ServiceNow capability.

Work on complex, high-visibility CRM transformation engagements.

We are looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to join our team!

Someone who has designed, built, operated and evolved distributed backend systems in production, understands how they fail, and knows how to make pragmatic technical decisions when there is no perfect solution.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture discussions and actual implementation.

#.NET #C# #DistributedSystems

Quick details

📍Portugal based
💻 Remote work model and flexible schedule
⚙️ Backend / C# / .NET / Azure
🏗️ Microservices & distributed systems
📨 Event-driven architecture

Your Mission

This is a hands-on technical role. You will design and build backend systems, make architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and help other engineers solve complex technical problems.

About Us

At Lyzer, we empower retailers and e-commerce businesses with innovative technology solutions, driving operational excellence and growth in a dynamic market.
Our mission is to revolutionize the logistics landscape, enabling unprecedented efficiency and exceptional customer experiences.
Our platform is based on microservices and asynchronous communication with an event-driven architecture, supporting a Logistics as a Service ecosystem.

Responsibilities (Your Day-to-Day)

Own and influence the architecture of critical backend systems across multiple domains
Design scalable and resilient solutions using C#, .NET and microservices

Design and evolve event-driven and asynchronous workflows

Define service boundaries, integration approaches and communication patterns
Make architectural decisions considering scalability, reliability, maintainability and operational complexity
Establish and promote engineering standards, patterns and best practices across teams
Help engineers make better technical decisions through mentoring, design reviews and code reviews
Drive improvements in performance, observability, testing, CI/CD and production reliability
Proactively identify technical risks and opportunities before they become problems

Requirements

8+ years of professional software development experience
, with significant experience building backend systems using C# and .NET
.
Strong hands-on experience designing and operating microservices and distributed systems in production
.
Proven experience with event-driven architectures
and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS or equivalent
.
Strong understanding of asynchronous systems and failure scenarios, including concepts such as: idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, eventual consistency, transactional messaging
Strong experience with relational databases and SQL Server
; Azure SQL experience is highly valued.
Strong understanding of software architecture and design principles such as DDD, SOLID and Clean Architecture
.
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure
, including serverless services such as Azure Functions.
Experience with automated testing, CI/CD and production observability.
Experience mentoring other engineers and influencing technical decisions across teams.
Good communication skills in English.
Previous experience using AI development assistants as part of the engineering workflow

Perks / Benefits

🍽️ Meal allowance card (x12 months)
🕰️ Remote work model and flexible schedule
💻 Computer to facilitate your work
💳 Competitive salary with fixed and variable income, allowing the individual to grow with the company
📚 Access to technical training platforms in different areas to support your professional development
🚀 Startup environment offering you a dynamic and collaborative culture where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
🏥 Other fringe benefits such as health insurance, gym or school-vouchers.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Legacy Specialist & AI Expert)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.
