Dinamikusan fejlődő csapatunkba olyan C# fejlesztőt keresünk, aki nyitott az új kihívásokra, szeret csapatban dolgozni, optimalizálni, és érdeklődik a vasúti hálózatok elemeinek, menetrendjének szimulálása és matematikai modellezése iránt, miközben aktívan hozzájárul a termék CRA-kompatibilitásának megteremtéséhez.

A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád:

Biztonságos kommunikáció fejlesztése: HTTPS implementáció a Sitras® Sidytrac Simulation Commander (SSC) számára, a meglévő interfészek kiterjesztése a biztonságos fájlátvitel érdekében.
Optimalizáló modul fejlesztése: Az optimalizáló modul interfészének kialakítása és implementálása az SSC-ben.
Legacy rendszerek modernizálása: Régebbi VB.NET interfészek portolása C# alapú interfészekre.
SSC modernizációja: Az SSC moduljainak fokozatos portolása VB.NET-ről C# assembly-kre, biztosítva a zökkenőmentes átállást és a kompatibilitást.
Rendszerstabilitás és biztonság: Aktív részvétel a szoftver stabilitásának biztosításában, hibák javításában és biztonsági rések felderítésében, elhárításában.

Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha:

Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel mérnöki/informatikai/természettudományi (matematika vagy fizika) területen.
Van legalább 3 év C# alapú szoftverfejlesztésben szerzett tapasztalatod.
Tárgyalóképes, magabiztos angol és német nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban.
Jártas vagy webszolgáltatások területén és REST API-k fejlesztésében.
Képes vagy önállóan dolgozni, de tudod, mikor kell segítséget kérni vagy együttműködni.
Nem riadsz vissza a komplex feladatoktól, és aktívan keresed a jobb megoldásokat.

A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben:

Van tapasztalatod cybersecurity területén (pl. titkosítás, tanusítványok, biztonsági rések azonosítása).
Jártas vagy az alábbiak valamelyikében: VB.NET, Git, felhőalapú technológiák.
Dolgoztál már agilis módszertan szerint.

Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk?

Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Entwickler (m/w/d) Legacy Specialist & AI Expert
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgabe

Du wirst Teil einer Initiative, die sich auf die Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung der internen Anwendungslandschaft
konzentriert. Dieses Projekt umfasst den strategischen Übergang bekannter Cloud-Services und Legacy-.NET-Architekturen in eine Next-Generation-, KI-erweiterte und Cloud-native Softwarelandschaft. Das Ziel besteht nicht einfach darin, das bestehende System zu warten, sondern es proaktiv zu transformieren – um Souveränität, hochperformante Skalierbarkeit und nahtlose Übergabebereitschaft durch diszipliniertes Engineering sicherzustellen.

Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf hochkomplexes Coding, tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering und KI-erweiterte Produktivität
. Du arbeitest in den Tiefen der Legacy-Codebasis, extrahierst Logik und implementierst moderne, testbare Lösungen unter Verwendung der neuesten KI-gestützten Entwicklungsumgebungen. Deine Mission besteht darin, die technische Umsetzung sowohl von wirkungsvoller Feature-Entwicklung als auch der tiefgreifenden Modernisierung des Legacy-.NET-Ökosystems voranzutreiben. Du bist ein Spezialist, der Zufriedenheit darin findet, komplexe Rätsel zu lösen und KI-gestützte Tools zu nutzen, um die Modernisierung von Kernsystemen zu beschleunigen.

Der Engineering-Ansatz operiert an der Schnittstelle von Legacy-Stabilität und moderner Innovation, nutzt KI-erweitertes Engineering mit fortschrittlichen KI-Entwicklungsumgebungen (wie Cursor, Windsurf und Claude Code), implementiert disziplinierte SDLC-Muster mit wiederholbaren, evidenzbasierten Ansätzen, priorisiert risikominimierte Evolution unter Verwendung des „Strangler Fig"-Modernisierungsmusters und agiert als schlanke, hochautonome Einheit, die technische Detektive schätzt, die Mehrdeutigkeit navigieren und tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering durchführen können.

Hauptaufgaben

Komplexe Features & Refactoring: Entwurf und Implementierung anspruchsvoller neuer Funktionalitäten innerhalb des bestehenden .NET-Ökosystems unter Sicherstellung nahtloser Integration mit Legacy-Komponenten
Tiefgreifendes Reverse Engineering: Analyse und Dekonstruktion komplexen, undokumentierten oder „Spaghetti"-Legacy-Codes, um zugrunde liegende Geschäftsregeln und technische Abläufe zu verstehen
KI-erweitertes Coding: Proaktive Nutzung von KI-Coding-Assistenten und fortschrittlichen Umgebungen (z.B. Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code oder VS Code Extensions), um Code-Verständnis, Dokumentation und Refactoring zu beschleunigen
Robustes Testing & Stabilität: Schreiben hochwertiger Unit- und Integrationstests, um Legacy-Module zu „umhüllen" und ein Sicherheitsnetz für alle Refactoring-Bemühungen bereitzustellen
Technisches Troubleshooting: Agieren als hochrangiger Eskalationspunkt für komplexe Bugs und Performance-Engpässe innerhalb der Legacy-Umgebung
Interne Tools: Nutzung von Microsoft PowerApps zum Aufbau schneller, leichtgewichtiger administrativer oder Wartungs-Utilities zur Unterstützung des Entwicklungs- und Betriebslebenszyklus

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen hocherfahrenen .NET/C# Senior Developer
mit fundierter Expertise in der Modernisierung von Legacy-Systemen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools und fortgeschrittenen Software-Engineering-Praktiken. Der ideale Kandidat ist ein technischer Detektiv, der sich durch Reverse Engineering komplexer Codebasen auszeichnet und robuste, testbare Lösungen implementiert.

Muss-Kriterien

Mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung
Fundierte Expertise im .NET/C#-Stack
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit älteren .NET-Versionen (z.B. .NET Framework)
Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Komplexitäten monolithischer Architekturen
Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Coding-Assistenten
Erfahrung mit Prompt Engineering oder Experimenten mit lokalen Modellen
Beherrschung der SOLID-Prinzipien
Beherrschung von Design Patterns
Fortgeschrittene Debugging-Techniken
Fortgeschrittene Profil
ing-Techniken
Starkes Engagement für TDD (Test-Driven Development)
Starkes Engagement für automatisierte Tests (Unit/Integration)

Über uns

Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Konzernen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern.

DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA
und wurde als ethischstes multinationales Unternehmen 2019
anerkannt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt kontinuierlich seine vier Standorte in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs und Szeged weiter und sucht qualifizierte IT-Fachkräfte, die Teil des Teams werden möchten.

Unternehmensrichtlinien

Die Möglichkeit zur Remote-Arbeit besteht aufgrund europäischer Steuervorschriften nur innerhalb Ungarns

jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To build the automated safety net that makes our modernization efforts possible. You will ensure that as we evolve the Internal Application Landscape, we maintain absolute functional parity and prevent any regressions in our mission-critical business logic.

Role Focus

This role focuses on building scalable automation frameworks and implementing AI-driven testing strategies. You will verify that modernized components produce identical business outcomes to the legacy systems they replace, using both traditional and AI-augmented testing techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Automated Regression & Parity Testing: Design and maintain comprehensive automated regression suites to protect legacy functionality and verify functional parity during migration.
AI-Augmented Testing: Leverage AI-powered tools for automated test generation, self-healing test scripts, and intelligent visual regression testing.
Framework Development: Build and optimize scalable automation frameworks (UI, API, and Integration levels) specifically tailored for .NET and modern cloud-native environments.
Continuous Testing (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into DevOps pipelines (GitLab/GitHub/Jenkins) to provide immediate, high-confidence feedback.
API & Integration Testing: Validate complex data flows and integrations between legacy monoliths and new, modern services.
Collaboration: Work side-by-side with Developers and Architects to identify "testable" areas in legacy code and advocate for improved testability.

Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years in automated software testing, with a strong background in software engineering/SDET.
Automation Mastery: Proficiency with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, and API testing frameworks (RestSharp, etc.).
AI/Modern Testing: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding/testing assistants and the ability to implement automated regression strategies in complex environments.
Programming Proficiency: Strong coding skills in C# to build and maintain sophisticated test automation code.
Analytical Rigor: A detective mindset with the ability to translate undocumented legacy behaviors into precise, automated test scenarios.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PUBLIC KEY INFRASTRUCTURE)
jobs.description:
Get to know the role

NETLOCK's certificate authority is the system behind every qualified certificate we issue - the platform that decides what a signature is actually worth. It has recently been modernised and now runs on Kubernetes. You'll own where it goes from here: the architecture, the reliability, and the cryptographic stack it's built on. This is a backend role, written in C, Go and Perl
. We don't expect all three on day one - we expect real strength in one and a genuine willingness to work across the rest. You'll develop the CA system and the independent services around it, work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services, and make architectural decisions in a system where correctness is the product. There is some web-related work, but it isn't the focus. You'll join a small, senior-leaning team that owns what it ships, from design through production. Cryptography and PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) experience is welcome, but it isn't a prerequisite: the domain is learnable, and we'll help you get there. What we can't teach is the appetite for taking long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it.

What we offer?

You will be part of a young, supportive, and dynamic team where junior and more experienced colleagues collaborate closely, support each other, and openly share their knowledge and experience.
You will work in a modern technology environment where you can freely use the latest tools, technologies, and AI-driven solutions to support your work and drive innovation.
To make your workdays more enjoyable, we provide unlimited coffee so you can recharge during breaks and informal moments with your colleagues.
We offer a competitive and above-market salary that reflects your expertise, performance, and the energy you invest in your work.
In addition to competitive base benefits, after successfully completing your probation period you will also receive a high-value cafeteria benefits package that can be flexibly tailored to your personal needs and lifestyle.
The health and well-being of our employees is important to us, which is why after your probation period we provide a comprehensive private health insurance package, allowing you to focus on your work while feeling secure in your everyday life.
In this role, you can expect a high degree of autonomy, giving space for initiative and ownership, while also offering opportunities for rapid professional growth and continuous learning.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for:

Own the PKI services end to end - architecture, development, maintenance, and how they behave in production.
Develop the certificate authority system and the independent services around it.
Keep the cryptographic stack current and lead upgrades to supported, long-term versions.
Work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services.
Make architectural decisions in a security-critical system and see them through to production.
Improve how we build, test, and ship - from local development to deployment.
Ship what you build and keep it healthy: observability, alerting, and a hand in on-call.

This opportunity is for you if you…

have senior-level software engineering experience, primarily in backend development, with a minimum of 3–5 years in production,
are strong in at least one of C, Go or Perl, and genuinely willing to learn and work in all three,
have experience with relational databases (we use MySQL),
have designed and operated systems made up of multiple independent services, and keep them correct across service boundaries,
take long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it,
are fluent with AI-assisted coding workflows,
pick up new languages and unfamiliar domains quickly, and find hard problems satisfying rather than draining,
are a native Hungarian speaker (spoken and written) with professional English.

It’s a plus if you...

bring cryptography or PKI knowledge of any kind - it isn't a prerequisite, but we're glad to see it,
have worked with OpenSSL, hardware crypto devices, or PKCS#11,
are at home with Kubernetes and its surrounding tooling,
have built CI/CD pipelines end to end, from build to deployment across Dev, Staging and Prod,
have a background in a regulated, security-critical domain (e.g. eIDAS, trust services, finance),
are open to picking up new scripting languages.

What happens after you apply?

Once your application reaches us, our team carefully reviews it to see how well your experience and skills match the role.
If there’s a strong fit, we’ll invite you to a short introductory phone call to go through the key details and get to know each other.
As a next step, you’ll be invited to a personal interview with our HR team and the hiring manager. This is a great opportunity for you to learn more about the role, the team, and ask any questions about the day-to-day work.

Who we are?

We are a global trust-technology company with more than 25 years of experience in digital identity, advanced cryptography, and qualified trust services. Originating in Hungary and operating internationally with offices in Florida, US and Budapest, HU, we combine European regulatory strength with global reach.

Our team includes one of the region’s largest groups of PKI specialists, cryptographers, and security engineers, experts who have helped shaping the foundations of modern digital trust. As one of Europe’s earliest Qualified Trust Service Providers, we pioneered solutions in electronic signatures, identity verification, cryptographic infrastructure, and content authenticity.
Today, we enable organizations not only to verify identities and sign securely, but to trust their digital world in a way that was never possible before. At the heart of this leap forward is our world-first twin-engine solution: the fusion of C2PA provenance and qualified electronic signatures. This breakthrough creates a verifiable chain of trust for any digital asset, from documents to images to complex media, redefining what authenticity means in the age of AI. It elevates our long-standing trust-service foundations into a new standard for digital truth.

As technology evolves, we are committed to integrating the latest breakthroughs in cryptography, provenance, and AI-driven verification, ensuring trust remains one step ahead of innovation. Our mission is simple: To restore trust in the digital world.

Das automatisierte Sicherheitsnetz aufzubauen, das Modernisierungsbemühungen ermöglicht. Du stellst sicher, dass während der Weiterentwicklung der internen Anwendungslandschaft absolute funktionale Parität gewahrt bleibt und jegliche Regressionen in geschäftskritischer Logik verhindert werden.

Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf den Aufbau skalierbarer Automatisierungs-Frameworks und die Implementierung KI-gestützter Teststrategien. Hauptaufgaben

Automatisierte Regressions- und Paritätstests: Entwicklung und Pflege umfassender automatisierter Regressions-Suites zum Schutz der Legacy-Funktionalität und zur Verifizierung funktionaler Parität während der Migration.
KI-gestütztes Testen: Nutzung KI-gestützter Tools für automatisierte Testgenerierung, selbstheilende Testskripte und intelligente visuelle Regressionstests.
Framework-Entwicklung: Aufbau und Optimierung skalierbarer Automatisierungs-Frameworks (UI-, API- und Integrationsebene), die speziell auf .NET- und moderne Cloud-native Umgebungen zugeschnitten sind.

API- und Integrationstests: Validierung komplexer Datenflüsse und Integrationen zwischen Legacy-Monolithen und neuen, modernen Services.
Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklern und Architekten, um „testbare" Bereiche im Legacy-Code zu identifizieren und für verbesserte Testbarkeit einzutreten.

Analytische Genauigkeit und detektivische Denkweise

jobs.description:
Penta Consulting are a technology resource solutions provider to leading OEMs across the EMEA region.

Role Overview

The Senior Laserfiche ECM Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting automation-centric ECM solutions using Laserfiche and Microsoft development technologies. The role focuses on workflow automation, digital forms, repository-driven business logic, and enterprise integrations that help transform manual processes into secure, scalable, and auditable digital services.

This position requires strong experience in C#, .NET, API-based integrations, and Laserfiche Forms / Workflow design, with the ability to convert business requirements into technical solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, administrators, records teams, and client stakeholders to deliver robust and supportable ECM capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Laserfiche Forms solutions for service requests, approvals, case management, onboarding, procurement, correspondence, and other digital workflows.
Build and optimize Laserfiche Workflow automations, including routing rules, escalations, notifications, approvals, metadata updates, SLA monitoring, and exception handling.
Develop C# / .NET integrations between Laserfiche and external enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, HRMS, email platforms, portals, identity services, and payment systems.
Implement API-based integrations using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, webhooks, or middleware patterns as required by the target architecture.
Translate business requirements into technical design documents, process maps, field structures, form logic, template usage, metadata models, and repository automation rules.
Support document capture and ingestion use cases, including imports, metadata assignment, validation rules, OCR-enabled processing, and structured content classification.
Prepare technical specifications, solution design documents, deployment plans, unit test cases, and release notes for each implemented solution.
Participate in sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, UAT support, hypercare, and production issue resolution activities.
Troubleshoot workflow failures, integration errors, performance bottlenecks, and form logic defects across development, test, and production environments.
Ensure that developed solutions comply with repository security rules, audit requirements, naming standards, and records governance principles.
Collaborate with administrators to align application behavior with access rights, roles, authentication methods, and platform constraints.
Contribute to reusable components, coding standards, and best practices for Laserfiche implementation within the project team.

Required Skills & Experience

Mandatory

Minimum 10 years of experience in enterprise application development or ECM/BPM solution delivery.
Minimum 4 years of hands-on Laserfiche development experience, including Forms and Workflow.
Strong programming experience in C#, .NET / .NET Core, and SQL.
Experience in designing and consuming APIs and integrating with third-party systems.
Ability to prepare technical documentation and support UAT / production deployment activities.
Good understanding of repository metadata, templates, field structures, and search-friendly information architecture.
Professional proficiency in English; Arabic is highly desirable.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Laserfiche Cloud experience
Experience in banking/government sectors
CI/CD tools exposure
Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, OCI)
Laserfiche certifications

Technical Stack / Tools

Laserfiche Forms / Business Processes
Laserfiche Workflow / Process Automation
C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET
REST / SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, web services
SQL Server, stored procedures, query optimization
JavaScript, HTML, CSS for form behavior and UI enhancement
Windows Server, IIS, Active Directory / SSO integration
Source control, test case management, and structured release procedures

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Technology Quality Assurance
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Senior Engineer - Technology Quality Assurance to take complete ownership of our end-to-end testing lifecycle. In this role, you will be the ultimate champion for software quality, ensuring every feature we release meets exceptional standards of functional precision, performance, and user experience.

As a primary quality representative, you will also interface directly with clients to understand feedback and demonstrate product updates. If you have a sharp eye for a polished product, fluent communication skills, and deep expertise across manual, automated, and performance testing, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Complete QA Ownership: Lead and execute the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) from initial requirement analysis and test planning to release sign-off and post-launch monitoring.
Automation Framework Design: Own, Build, maintain, and scale robust automated test suites (UI and API) to accelerate integration and regression testing cycles.
Performance & Load Testing: Plan, script, and execute load, stress, and performance tests to ensure systems remain fast, scalable, and resilient under heavy traffic.
Manual & Exploratory Testing: Conduct thorough manual and exploratory testing to catch edge cases, usability flaws, and visual inconsistencies that automated scripts miss.
Product Polish Advocate: Serve as the ultimate filter for product quality, ensuring UI/UX flows are intuitive, seamless, and pixel-perfect prior to release.
Agile Integration: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Designers in an Agile/Scrum environment to refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prevent defects early in the sprint cycle.
Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track bugs to resolution using JIRA (or similar tools), providing clear reproduction steps and detailed diagnostics.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines to enable continuous feedback and rapid delivery cycles.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience as a QA Engineer working on web and mobile applications.
Must have exceptional, highly competent verbal and written English skills for clear documentation, team collaboration, and professional client interactions.
Proven experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
Solid background in performance testing tools like JMeter, K6, or Gatling.
Strong expertise across manual, API (REST/GraphQL via Postman or RestAssured), cross-browser, and performance testing methodologies.
Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with active participation in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
An exceptional eye for detail with a relentless drive to ensure products look, feel, and function flawlessly.
Comfortable writing SQL queries for database verification, inspecting network calls, and analyzing system logs.
Confident and willing to engage directly with clients and stakeholders as needed.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience presenting technical demos or managing UAT sessions with client stakeholders.
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Familiarity with security testing practices and OWASP principles.
ISTQB certification or equivalent software testing credential.

Our Benefits & Perks

Competitive compensation packages and comprehensive medical insurance to support you and your family.
Wellbeing-focused initiatives and resources, designed to enhance your personal and professional life.
Access to exclusive discount programs, offering savings across various lifestyle and leisure experiences across the UAE.

What Makes a Great Fit

If you are performance-driven and possess an inquisitive mind with the agility to navigate ambiguity, you will thrive here. At the heart of the Space42 community is a bias for action and a passion for developing innovative, efficient space services through AI-driven smart solutions that drive technological advancements and create a better tomorrow.

new_jobs.description:
Description

About the Client

Our client is a global leader in eye care, dedicated to improving lives by enhancing sight. With a strong portfolio of innovative products—including contact lenses, eye care solutions, and surgical instruments for cataract and retina procedures—they serve customers in over 140 countries. By advancing cutting-edge technologies and solutions, they continue to shape the future of eye health worldwide.

About The Project

As part of their ongoing innovation, our client is enhancing their medical devices with advanced connectivity features and cloud-based services. Since adoption of next-generation solutions is gradual, the project must ensure smooth integration between legacy and modern systems in real-world environments.

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. To achieve this, our client is now scaling up the software engineering team and seeking skilled professionals to join this critical phase of development.

Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. Both systems are safety-classified software under IEC 62304 and require rigorous test coverage. The Scrum Master is a key role responsible for enabling team effectiveness and high-quality delivery in a safety-critical, highly regulated environment.

Core Qualifications Include:

3+ years of experience in exploratory or hands-on functional software testing, ideally on real embedded hardware or medical devices.
Familiarity with Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) or comparable structured exploratory testing approaches.
Practical experience with Azure DevOps (backlog management, sprint boards, defect tracking, build/release pipelines).
Solid understanding of Windows desktop application testing (UI workflows, configuration, error handling).
Ability to read and interpret C++ application architecture and system integration diagrams for test planning purposes.
Experience working in Agile teams using feature-driven development, time-boxing, and artifact management.
Interpersonal skills with a proven ability to achieve constructive solutions in cross-departmental topics, as well as in organizing and motivating team members.
Fluent English; intermediate-level German. Onsite, Erlangen, no home office

Job responsibilities

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies for the FrontEnd team (sprint planning, daily stand-up, sprint review, retrospective) and optionally a second team (VideoUnit).
Coach team members on Agile/Scrum principles, continuous improvement, and self-organization; act as a servant leader and team advocate.
Identify and actively remove impediments; manage cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers to management as needed.
Maintain team health metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, defect aging) and communicate progress transparently to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, sprint goal clarity, and Definition of Done alignment.
Support adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tooling within the team.
Facilitate continuous process improvement using retrospective data; drive Agile maturity across one or two Scrum teams.
Plan, design, and execute exploratory test sessions on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device (hardware-in-the-loop), focusing on clinical user workflows of the FrontEnd application.
Apply Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) and exploratory test charters; document findings with clear reproducibility steps and severity classification.
Collaborate with software engineers and verification engineers to triage defects; create and track issues in Azure DevOps.
Contribute to test strategy and risk-based coverage decisions alongside the Quality and Architecture team.
Produce lightweight test artifacts required under IEC 62304 (test session reports, defect records, anomaly reports) in coordination with the Quality team.
Validate integration of FrontEnd with BackEnd, VideoUnit, and Refractive Server Device (RSD) at the system level during sprint deliveries.

What we offer

Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.

Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.

DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity
. We are dedicated to providing equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive
and empowering work environment.

Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.

Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.

Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

PoCs and MVPs in AI transformation projects inside enterprise ERP software - rapid exploration of new capabilities, with the engineering discipline to evolve the successful ones into production-grade services.

Production readiness - bringing R&D output up to enterprise standard: reliability, observability, security, multi-tenancy, and safe failure behaviour.
AI engineering - integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into business software responsibly: guardrails, permissions, auditability, and designing for the probabilistic nature of AI components acting on real business data.
Raising the bar - architectural review across the team's workstreams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and turning good judgement into standards and automation rather than tribal knowledge.

What You Are Likely To Bring

Principal-level engineering depth in C#/.NET and/or Python, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), and a strong record of designing and shipping production services. Our systems span both stacks - strength in one with working fluency in the other is the expectation.
Production TypeScript/JavaScript frontend engineering experience, including building secure, accessible user interfaces that integrate with enterprise web shells, APIs and backend services.
Experience designing and integrating enterprise information systems, with a strong understanding of data flows, system boundaries and the operational impact of change.
Ability to work effectively with data scientists and other AI specialists to turn data, models and experimentation into reliable, usable product capabilities.
Production ownership experience - you have run systems in production and carry the instincts that come from it: partial failure, resilience, blast-radius thinking, and designing for the incident nobody planned. This matters to us more than any specific framework.
Distributed-systems fluency: service boundaries, transactional thinking, multi-tenant design, API design and versioning.
Strong architectural communication - able to explain, document, and defend design decisions across teams, and to review others' designs constructively.
Pragmatism under real-world constraints: comfortable integrating with large, long-lived enterprise systems and choosing the achievable-good over the theoretical-perfect.

Highly Desirable

Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted engineering - building with LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, and prompt-driven workflows, and a grounded view of where they help and where they don't.
Experience taking early-stage products (PoC/MVP) to production, ideally in enterprise software.
AWS experience.
Complex business-domain experience - ERP, e-commerce, finance, logistics - and an appreciation of the cost of getting business data wrong.
Security instincts: least privilege, tenancy isolation, trust boundaries.

Deliver production-quality code

Czerpiemy z doświadczenia Etteplanu w inżynierii, dokumentacji technicznej i automatyzacji, tworząc aplikacje, które łączą świat IT z rzeczywistymi procesami przemysłowymi.

Z fińską prostotą podchodzimy do rozwiązywania problemów – bez zbędnych warstw i skomplikowanych procedur. Liczy się współpraca, zaufanie i wspólne poszukiwanie lepszych sposobów działania.

Tworzymy i wdrażamy nowoczesne systemy MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems)

i chemicznej

.

Dlaczego warto?

Ta rola to wyjątkowa szansa, by połączyć pasję do programowania z praktycznym wpływem na przemysł
. Zobaczysz, jak Twoje rozwiązania usprawniają realne linie produkcyjne i wpływają na codzienną pracę tysięcy ludzi. Jeśli chcesz rozwijać się w kierunku integracji IT i automatyki – to idealne miejsce, by zacząć.

Nasza firma specjalizuje się w integracji technologii IT z produkcją przemysłową, koncentrując się głównie na branży spożywczej i chemicznej. Współpracujemy z największymi firmami produkcyjnymi na całym świecie, wdrażając innowacyjne rozwiązania oparte na platformie Systemowej oraz Model-Driven MES od AVEVA.

kierowanie procesem tworzenia, konfiguracji i wdrażania nowoczesnych systemów produkcji cyfrowej,
współpracę z klientami w celu zbierania i przekładania wymagań dotyczących projektów i usprawniania procesów na szczegółową dokumentację projektową,

tworzenie i rozwój interfejsów użytkownika w Angular, C#, JavaScript i ASP.Net Core,
projektowanie i opracowywanie raportów produkcyjnych w AVEVA Historian,
zapewnienie wsparcia technicznego i operacyjnego automatyzacji dla działów inżynierii, produkcji czy utrzymania ruchu,
koordynowanie i wspieranie działań związanych z uruchamianiem projektów,
mentorowanie i szkolenie młodszych inżynierów,
budowanie i utrzymywanie silnych relacji partnerskich z zespołami projektowymi i klientami w celu identyfikacji obszarów do poprawy procesów poprzez technologię automatyzacji i analizy danych,
badanie nowych technologii i trendów w produkcji cyfrowej.

posiadasz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie jako inżynier produkcji cyfrowej, szczególnie z produktami AVEVA (Wonderware) (IDE, MES (Performance Operations, Quality), Batch, WEI, itp.),

posiadasz umiejętności programowania webowego, w tym JavaScript, CSS, JSON, JQuery, Web API, HTML5 i/lub REST API,

new_jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
new_jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.
You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
Hands-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
A working understanding of distributed, service-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

This is your opportunity to work on a world-leading, high-performance, high-availability, and high-throughput multi-brand Sportsbook platform.

To give you an idea of the scale behind our applications

10,000 different leagues
1,100 live matches
500,000–600,000 bets placed on a single Saturday

The Wow

You'll join more than 150 agile engineers
distributed across 3 locations
, working with a modern technology stack that includes Angular, TypeScript, .NET Core, C#, RabbitMQ, SQL Server, NoSQL databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

We work in cross-functional agile teams
consisting of architects, developers, QA engineers, database specialists, DevOps engineers, and product owners, giving you the opportunity to contribute across the entire software development lifecycle.

If you're passionate about building both exceptional user experiences and scalable backend systems, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and thrive in mission-critical environments, then this is the role for you.

Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800
colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices
- including 1,500
at our operational headquarters in Malta - every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson.

A taster of what you will be involved with

Frontend

Angular
TypeScript
ngRx (Redux pattern)
RxJS
Angular Material
HTML/CSS
SignalR

Backend

.NET / C#
.NET Core
ASP.NET Web API
SQL Server
NoSQL databases
RabbitMQ (or similar messaging technologies)

What we are looking for

Developing modern web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern UI framework (Angular preferred)
Building scalable backend services with .NET / C#
Designing and consuming REST APIs
Working across complex distributed and microservice-based architectures
Working with SQL Server and NoSQL databases
Writing clean, maintainable, and testable code
Using unit testing frameworks
Applying Agile software development practices
Collaborating with cross-functional teams and sharing knowledge
Communicating effectively in English

Extra Awesome

Strong experience with Angular, ngRx, and RxJS
Experience implementing distributed, multi-tier, or microservice-based systems
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with responsive web design
Knowledge of SQL query optimisation and database performance tuning
Experience with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ or Kafka

What we offer

Fitness-wellness allowance  🧗‍♂️
Company mobile phone for private use with 100 GB  📱
Annual HUF devaluation compensation  💡
Hybrid model 3 days in the office 🏢  & 2 days from home  🏠
Private Health Insurance  🩺
Career development  📈
Technical and soft-skill training opportunities 🎓
Breakfast, fruits & lunch 🍎
Team building events  🥳
